answer: The kernel schedule is applied in mirror and raven shows each instalment. An adversary hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 55% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1375 identities would post 2554 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
